_comment: Passed with --settings to the headless SessionEnd wrap-up child by .claude/hooks/session-wrapup.cjs. That child runs with --permission-mode auto and a prompt telling it to commit, so this PreToolUse hook is its gate: it refuses whole-tree staging, discarding uncommitted work, force-shaped pushes, and writes to .claude/skills/** or SOUL.md and USER.md.
_grant_comment: wrapup-guard.cjs emits permissionDecision allow once its checks clear, which makes it the sole gate for this child: a bare exit 0 is read by the CLI as no opinion, and a --print child has nobody to ask, so it would refuse everything. The deny list in the guard is therefore load-bearing. A payload the guard cannot classify stays silent and so fails closed.
_merge_comment: One --settings flag merges with the settings of the folder the child starts in. A second --settings would replace the first, so anything else this child needs has to be added to this file.
